secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app id (from the Base44 Builder app settings), sent as the X-App-Id header. Defaults to the app's own id in .env.base44-defaults.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base44 backend base URL; the vite plugin proxies /api -> this URL. Left unset so the preview renders (the app's login is not embeddable — X-Frame-Options: DENY). Set to https://app.base44.com to wire the live backend, which shows an in-preview login and loads real data.
